1
Nkyea
1Paulo, Nyankopɔn akoa ne Yesu Kristo somafoɔ ma wɔn a Onyankopɔn ayi wɔn gyidie ne onyamesom pa ho nokorɛ no nimdeɛ, 2daa nkwa anidasoɔ so, nkwa a Onyankopɔn a ɔnni atorɔ no de firi teteete hyɛɛ bɔ, 3#Efe 1.9-10; 1 Ti 1.1; 1.11 na ɛberɛ a ɛsɛ mu, ɔyii n’asɛm adie, asɛnka a wɔnam yɛn Agyenkwa Nyankopɔn hyɛ so de ahyɛ me nsa no mu, 4#1 Ti 1.2 de kɔma Tito, me ba pa gyidie korɔ no ara fam. Adom ne asomdwoeɛ a ɛfiri Agya Nyankopɔn ne Kristo Yesu, yɛn Agyenkwa no, nka wo!
Esu a ɛfata ɔhwɛfoɔ
5Yei nti na megyaa wo Kreta, na woasiesie nnoɔma a aka no pɛpɛɛpɛ, na woasisi kuro biara so mpanimfoɔ, sɛdeɛ mehyɛɛ woɔ no: 6#1 Ti 3.2-4 Deɛ ne ho nni asɛm bie, ɔyerɛ baako kunu a ɔwɔ mma gyidifoɔ a wɔnte ahohwie anaa asoɔden nka wɔ wɔn ho. 7#1 Ko 4.1; 2 Ti 2.24 Na deɛ ɛsɛ ɔhwɛfoɔ ne sɛ: Wɔnni ne ho asɛm bi ka, sɛ Nyankopɔn fiehwɛfoɔ. Ɔnyɛ ɔhopɛfoɔ, abufufafoɔ, ɔsadweam, pupopupo, anaa odufudepɛfoɔ, 8na mmom ɔpɛ ahɔhoyɛ, ɔpɛ papa, n’adwene mu te, ɔtene, ne ho te, ɔwɔ ahohyɛsoɔ, 9ɔsɔ nokwasɛm no mu sɛdeɛ wɔkyerɛɛ no no, na watumi de nkyerɛkyerɛ pa no atu fo, na wayi akyinnyegyefoɔ atɛn.
Kreta asafo mu agyegyefoɔ
10Ɛfiri sɛ ahuhusɛnkafoɔ ne nnaadaafoɔ atuatefoɔ bebree wɔ hɔ, ne titire no wɔn a wɔfiri twetiatwa mu 11#2 Ti 3.6 a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtua wɔn ano. Wɔn na aniwuo mfasoɔ nti wɔkyerɛkyerɛ deɛ ɛnsɛ, de dane afie ani butuo. 12Wɔn mu bi a ɔyɛ wɔn ara wɔn diyifoɔ kaa sɛ:
Kretafoɔ yɛ atorofoɔ daa, mmoa bɔne, akwadwofoɔ adidifoɔ.
Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ atorofoɔ
13 # 2 Ti 4.2 Adanseɛ yi yɛ nokorɛ. Ɛno nti yi wɔn atɛn ketee, na wɔn ho ayɛ wɔn den gyidie mu, 14#1 Ti 4.7 na wɔanyɛ aso amma Yudafoɔ anansesɛm ne nnipa a wɔdane wɔn ho firi nokorɛ ho no ahyɛdeɛ. 15#Mat 15.11; Rom 14.20 Adeɛ nyinaa ho te ma wɔn a wɔn ho teɛ; na wɔn a wɔn ho aba fi na wɔnnye nnie no deɛ, hwee ho nte mma wɔn, na mmom wɔn adwene ne wɔn ahonim nyinaa ho aba fi. 16#2 Ti 3.5 Wɔka sɛ wɔnim Onyankopɔn, nanso wɔde wɔn nnwuma po no. Wɔyɛ akyiwadeyɛfoɔ ne asoɔdenfoɔ, na wɔmfra mma adwuma pa biara.

pageProps.chapterText:
Paulo, Nyankopɔn akoa ne Yesu Kristo somafoɔ ma wɔn a Onyankopɔn ayi wɔn gyidie ne onyamesom pa ho nokorɛ no nimdeɛ, daa nkwa anidasoɔ so, nkwa a Onyankopɔn a ɔnni atorɔ no de firi teteete hyɛɛ bɔ, na ɛberɛ a ɛsɛ mu, ɔyii n’asɛm adie, asɛnka a wɔnam yɛn Agyenkwa Nyankopɔn hyɛ so de ahyɛ me nsa no mu, de kɔma Tito, me ba pa gyidie korɔ no ara fam. Adom ne asomdwoeɛ a ɛfiri Agya Nyankopɔn ne Kristo Yesu, yɛn Agyenkwa no, nka wo!

Yei nti na megyaa wo Kreta, na woasiesie nnoɔma a aka no pɛpɛɛpɛ, na woasisi kuro biara so mpanimfoɔ, sɛdeɛ mehyɛɛ woɔ no: Deɛ ne ho nni asɛm bie, ɔyerɛ baako kunu a ɔwɔ mma gyidifoɔ a wɔnte ahohwie anaa asoɔden nka wɔ wɔn ho. Na deɛ ɛsɛ ɔhwɛfoɔ ne sɛ: Wɔnni ne ho asɛm bi ka, sɛ Nyankopɔn fiehwɛfoɔ. Ɔnyɛ ɔhopɛfoɔ, abufufafoɔ, ɔsadweam, pupopupo, anaa odufudepɛfoɔ, na mmom ɔpɛ ahɔhoyɛ, ɔpɛ papa, n’adwene mu te, ɔtene, ne ho te, ɔwɔ ahohyɛsoɔ, ɔsɔ nokwasɛm no mu sɛdeɛ wɔkyerɛɛ no no, na watumi de nkyerɛkyerɛ pa no atu fo, na wayi akyinnyegyefoɔ atɛn.

Ɛfiri sɛ ahuhusɛnkafoɔ ne nnaadaafoɔ atuatefoɔ bebree wɔ hɔ, ne titire no wɔn a wɔfiri twetiatwa mu a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtua wɔn ano. Wɔn na aniwuo mfasoɔ nti wɔkyerɛkyerɛ deɛ ɛnsɛ, de dane afie ani butuo. Wɔn mu bi a ɔyɛ wɔn ara wɔn diyifoɔ kaa sɛ:
Kretafoɔ yɛ atorofoɔ daa, mmoa bɔne, akwadwofoɔ adidifoɔ.


Adanseɛ yi yɛ nokorɛ. Ɛno nti yi wɔn atɛn ketee, na wɔn ho ayɛ wɔn den gyidie mu, na wɔanyɛ aso amma Yudafoɔ anansesɛm ne nnipa a wɔdane wɔn ho firi nokorɛ ho no ahyɛdeɛ. Adeɛ nyinaa ho te ma wɔn a wɔn ho teɛ; na wɔn a wɔn ho aba fi na wɔnnye nnie no deɛ, hwee ho nte mma wɔn, na mmom wɔn adwene ne wɔn ahonim nyinaa ho aba fi. Wɔka sɛ wɔnim Onyankopɔn, nanso wɔde wɔn nnwuma po no. Wɔyɛ akyiwadeyɛfoɔ ne asoɔdenfoɔ, na wɔmfra mma adwuma pa biara.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
